pages.why: Specifies scope of supply for WSWS transfer pumps (2W+1S) and Lamella Clarifiers (1W+1S).
Specifies that the hydraulics of the ETP are designed to take an occasional overloading of 20% of the design flow rate.
Specifies ETP operation and control philosophy requiring automatic starting of standby pumps upon failure/tripping of running pump.
P&ID of Effluent Treatment Plant showing WSWS Transfer Pumps (3x50%, 125 m3/hr each) feeding Lamella Clarifier/Tube Settler (250 m3/hr each, 1W+1S).
Datasheet A for ETP specifying WSWS Transfer Pumps as Three (2W+1S) nos. with rated capacity of 125 m3/hr each.
Datasheet A for ETP specifying Lamella Clarifier/Tube Settler as Two (1W+1S) nos. with design flow of 250 m3/hr each.

General technical requirement for pumps stating motor rating is selected for parallel operation considering overloading in the event of tripping of operating pumps, not simultaneous operation of standby.

output.why: The three WSWS transfer pumps are configured as 2 working + 1 standby (3 x 50% at 125 m3/hr each) to match the single working downstream Lamella Clarifier's design flow of 250 m3/hr. Running all three pumps simultaneously without a standby violates the 2W+1S redundancy requirement and delivers 375 m3/hr (a 50% overload), exceeding the ETP's maximum occasional hydraulic overload limit of 20% (300 m3/hr) and the 200 NB discharge header sizing.
